summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing a Mutual Stock Purchase and Asset Exchange Agreement with SOD Sciences. Vivos will issue 12,000 shares of newly created Series C Convertible Preferred Stock, stated value $1,000 per share and $12 million aggregate, in exchange for 2,907,338 SOD common shares, at least 11% of SOD's fully diluted capital, and a 50% co-ownership interest in the pseudohypoxia early-warning Test and related IP. No cash consideration or advisors were involved. Closing is expected October 15, 2026. The Series C Preferred ranks pari passu with Series A and senior to common stock; no mandatory dividends. Watch for closing completion, Series C conversion terms, and potential overhang from the new preferred.
